slots.exemplo: Scroll down and watch everything fall into place
A single moment, held in place before everything begins to move.

Everything settles into place, leaving a lasting frame that feels
            complete.

Moments stack, overlap, and reveal themselves slowly as the scroll
            continues.

Elements carry presence, easing in and out with balance, never
            rushed, never still.

Subtle shifts and gentle transitions that build a quiet sense of
            rhythm as you move forward.

A quiet progression of motion and stillness, where each layer reveals
        itself with intention and nothing feels out of place.
